perks.description: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

enhanced.description: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers additional ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

perks.description: Hitting an enemy with every pellet in a shot increases melee damage for a short duration.

enhanced.name: One-Two Punch
enhanced.description: Hitting a target with nearly every pellet in a shot increases melee damage for a short duration.

perks.name: Lead from Gold

enhanced.description: Picking up Heavy ammo also grants increased ammo to this weapon.

enhanced.name: Trench Barrel

perks.name: Closing Time
perks.description: Improves range, accuracy, and handling as the magazine gets lower.

enhanced.name: Closing Time
enhanced.description: Further improves range, accuracy, and handling as the magazine gets lower.

perks.description: Each final blow with this weapon creates an elemental damage explosion.

enhanced.name: Chain Reaction

perks.description: Rapid final blows spawn a [Stasis] Stasis crystal near the victim's location.

enhanced.description: Rapid final blows spawn a larger Stasis crystal near the victim's location.

flavor: "Imagine that as the last sound you hear." —Petra Venj
